'''2020 MPC Tom Haid LS Diplomatic Mission To Alderaan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tom Haid]] at [[2020 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Tom Haid]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Diplomatic Mission To Alderaan / A Weakness Can Be Found|V3-L-diplomaticmissiontoalderaan.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Diplomatic Mission To Alderaan 17.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-match-play-championships/ PC list] Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013162034/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2020-match-play-championships.html Internet Archive]
